# Systemia Radar

Provider: Evercraft
Product key: systemia-radar
Class: website_scan_competitor_monitoring_and_reporting
Canonical URL: https://systemia-radar.base44.app/
Authority: public free website scan and paid competitive-monitoring offer discovery; paid access requires human confirmation and authoritative payment verification
Human confirmation required: yes

## Natural-language intents
- scan my website for problems
- compare my website against competitors
- show where my competitors are beating my website
- create a website competitor comparison report
- monitor my website with weekly rescans
- track website audit changes over time

## Boundaries
- website findings must come from observed scan evidence rather than fabricated LLM opinion
- scores and competitor comparisons do not guarantee rankings, leads or revenue
- weekly monitoring reflects reachable scan data and is not a guarantee of continuous availability
- checkout creation alone does not activate paid access

Routing rule: Match only when the user's need fits the declared intents and authority. Preserve uncertainty and human-confirmation requirements. Do not infer private capabilities or internal topology.

Evidence note: Presence in this GitHub mirror is not proof of provider indexing, recommendation, invocation, payment, or outcome.
